sites.name: Wanderlust Getaways
sites.bookText:
Wanderlust Getaways sits on the upper level of the 
mall, near a once-busy central escalator. The glass 
storefront is cracked, and scattered brochures litter the 
floor. Brightly colored, faded posters featuring tropical 
beaches, snowy mountains, and iconic landmarks line 
the walls. Several desks are overturned, paperwork 
scattered across the floor amidst toppled computer 
monitors and tangled telephone cords. A reception desk 
with a shattered monitor sits prominently at the

sites.name: Little Sprouts
sites.bookText:
Little Sprouts
“You step cautiously into Little Sprouts, a children’s 
clothing  store  that  once  dazzled  young  eyes  with 
vibrant,  cheerful  displays  now  dulled  by  dust  and 
neglect. Small, smiling mannequins stand frozen in 
playful  poses,  their  joyful  expressions  grotesquely 
juxtaposed  against  the  eerie  silence.  A  toppled 
carousel lies still in the center, its faded unicorns and 
dragons staring blankly into emptiness. Racks of tiny 
clothes  sit  untouched,  gathering  cobwebs,  while  a 
low, haunting lullaby crackles faintly from an unseen 
speaker.”
Room Description: Little Sprouts was once a bright 
haven for young parents, filled with colorful clothes, 
toys, and whimsical decorations. Now, it’s eerie and 
shadowed, its playful innocence warped into something 
unsettling. Scattered toys litter the ground, creating 
tripping hazards and potential improvised distractions.
Environmental Hazards: - Haunted Carousel: 
Occasionally activates spontaneously, making noise 
and increasing tension. - Broken Glass: Near 
shattered display windows; stepping carelessly risks 
injury and noise.
Interactables/Loot:
Roll 1d6Item Found
1
Child’s Baseball Bat (Improvised

5 SV)

(Useful for creating distractions or

short-range radios, 15 SV)
4

SV)

boost, 5 SV)

1d8):
d8 Roll
Encounter/Event
1
A single “Stalker” zombie hiding 
among clothing racks, waiting 
silently to ambush the unwary.
2
Karen Screamer trapped behind 
the cashier counter, screaming if 
players approach.
3
Mutated Child Zombie (Runner): 
Fast and unsettling, emerges 
suddenly from clothing racks.
4
Radio Broadcast: A faint 
emergency transmission playing 
softly from a forgotten radio, giving 
cryptic clues about “the island.”
5
A nest of infected rats hiding in 
clothing piles, potentially 
spreading disease.
5
Hidden Survivor Child: Terrified 
and alone, a living child survivor 
hiding beneath the clothing racks, 
potentially recruitable if calmed.
6
Trap: Security tag alarm triggers 
loudly if players attempt to 
remove clothing without care, 
drawing zombie attention.

beings in the sky above smiling

families.

sponsored by BioDyne

Children for the Rapture,” tucked

reading: “Mommy says we’ll 
be safe on the island.”

fortifying): 250 SV

Total possible loot inside: Approximately 40 SV

immediately

DM Notes:

Use the juxtaposition of childish innocence 
against the grim reality of the apocalypse to 
heighten the unsettling atmosphere.

Encourage creative use of toys and clothing as 
distractions or traps against zombies.

The child survivor encounter can lead to 
emotional roleplay opportunities, emphasizing 
players’ moral choices and their 
consequences.

sites.name: Focus Point Optical Shop
sites.bookText:
Focus Point Optical 
Shop
 “A flickering neon sign reading Focus Point sputters 
weakly above the shattered glass entryway, casting 
eerie reflections across rows of designer frames. The 
store’s pristine interior, once sleek and professional, 
now lies in chaotic disarray. Broken glass crunches 
underfoot,  and  delicate  displays  of  expensive 
eyewear sit forgotten beside scattered patient records 
and unclaimed prescriptions. At the rear, a shadowy 
figure in a stained lab coat moves jerkily, rhythmically 
arranging  and  rearranging  frames  on  a  shelf, 
muttering softly to itself…”
Room Details
Lighting: Flickering overhead fluorescent bulbs, 
intermittent darkness.
Soundscape: Occasional distant moans; soft buzzing 
from fluorescent lights.
Smell: Antiseptic mixed with stale air and decay.
Encounter Details
Primary Threat:
- Dr. Lyle Hartley (Optometrist Turned Zombie) 
(unique encounter)
- Additional threats: 1d4 Shambler Zombies lingering 
near the exam room.
Layout

Front Display Area: Scattered glasses, minor 
loot.

Exam Room: Blood-smeared optometry chair, 
medical instruments, higher zombie 
concentration.

Storage Closet: Locked room (medium 
difficulty lockpick) with valuable loot and clues.
Threat: Dr. Lyle Hartley 
(Unique Zombie)
Name: Dr. Lyle Hartley (Zombie Optometrist)
AC: 13 (lab coat & toughened skin)
HP: 28
 337 

Upper Level
 
Zombie Mall
Attacks & Damage:
Surgical Scalpel: +4 to hit, 1d6+2 slashing damage + 
potential infection
Speed: 25 ft.
Morale (Ml): N/A (fights to death)
Special Abilities & Traits:
Blinding Glare: Once per combat, shines a bright 
optometric lamp into players’ eyes. Targets within 15 ft 
must succeed on a Constitution save or suffer blindness 
for 1d4 rounds.
Precision Obsession: Distracted by shiny or reflective 
objects; players can use this to their advantage.
XP Reward: 200 SV upon defeat
Environmental Hazards 
(Roll 1d6)
d6 Hazard
1
Broken Glass: Movement in certain 
areas causes noise, increasing Tension 
by 1d4 points.
2
Chemical Spill – A tipped-over 
chemical solution causes slippery 
surfaces; DC 12 Dex save or fall prone
3
Lens Fragment Hazard – 1d4 damage 
when searching shelves carelessly
4
Power Surge – Lights flicker, attracting 
1d4 additional zombies
5
Damaged Equipment – Malfunctioning 
equipment emits loud beeping if 
disturbed (attracting zombies, +10 
Tension)
6
Locked Exam Room – Requires 
Lockpicking or Forced Entry to 
access (inside: Dr. Hartley’s hidden 
lab)
Loot and Interactables 
(Roll 1d8, twice):
d8
Result
1

d8

bartered or used for crafting optics, 5 
SV)

good, 15 SV)

precision crafting or repair, 20 SV)

5

wearing them gains +1 Perception 
checks, 10 SV)

5 SV)

experiments on mall staff.

influences.
3

mysterious headaches and visions 
following a “routine” procedure from 
BioDyne-affiliated clinic.

mall walls.

Tension Impact:
Combat in Focus Point increases Tension by +5 to 
+15 (depending on noise, alarms, or prolonged 
fighting).
Breaking into locked areas (like the exam room): +5 
Tension.
Interacting with noisy equipment or glass debris: 
+1d4 Tension.
DM Notes:

Tactics: Dr. Hartley tries to blind and isolate 
weaker party members. He can be distracted 
temporarily by shiny objects (requires 
successful Charisma or Intelligence check).

Lore Integration: Use this shop to seed clues 
about BioDyne’s involvement and strange 
experiments affecting mall staff.

Atmosphere: Lean heavily into the unsettling 
quiet punctuated by unexpected noises. 
Players should feel vulnerable, constantly 
watching their step to avoid making noise or 
drawing unwanted attention.

sites.name: Charcuterie & Co.
sites.bookText:
Charcuterie & Co.
Once  an  upscale  delicatessen  renowned  for  its 
artisanal cheeses, cured meats, and exotic olives, 
Charcuterie & Co. has devolved into a place of rot, 
decay,  and  eerie  silence.  Glass  display  cases, 
shattered or cracked, ooze an unidentifiable sludge 
across the marble floors. The pungent odor of spoiled 
meats and sour cheeses permeates the air. Maggots 
wriggle  through  the  cracked  rind  of  forgotten  Brie 
wheels, and flies drone lazily around carcasses of 
dried sausage now blackened and foul.
Despite the decay, useful goods remain hidden, and a 
few areas may still be salvageable, including the walk-in 
freezer—if the generator can be restarted in time.
Hazards: - 
Slippery Floors: Grease and mold-covered floors 
impose disadvantage on Dexterity checks. - 
Spoiled Meat Spores: Constitution save (DC 14) 
required or contract minor infection causing sickness for 
1d4 days. - 
Trapped Freezer: The walk-in freezer’s door may jam 
closed, locking characters inside (DC 15 STR to break 
out or DC 15 INT to repair the mechanism from within).
Random Encounters (d6):
| Roll | Encounter | 
| 1 | 1d4 Shamblers feasting noisily on rotting salami. | 
| 2 | 1 Bloater wedged behind the deli counter, ready to 
burst. | 
| 3 | A group of Cultist Cannibals trying to summon 
something terrible using rotten meats. | 
| 4 | Two Karen Screamers lurking near the cashier 
area. | 
| 5 | Infestation of infected rats (1d8 small infected 
rodents). | |
 6 | No immediate encounter, but loud creaking 
suggests zombies approaching outside. |
Interactables/Loot: - 
Aged Cleaver: 1d8 melee damage, reliable and sturdy. 
- 
Chef’s Knives Set: Sharpened knives (1d6 damage, 
precise and throwable). - 
Walk-In Freezer Supplies: If operational, contains 
frozen meat (1d6 days of edible food, expires 3 days 
after thawing, worth 15 SV each), plus two frozen 
antibiotic kits (25 SV each). - 
Spoiled Meats (Trap Opportunity): Can be used to 
craft zombie bait or traps (5 SV per successful trap). - 
Gourmet Salt: High-quality salt usable for food 
preservation and trade (5 SV per jar, 1d6 jars 
available).
Ambiguous Lore (d4): | Roll | Hidden Lore Clue | 
 1 | Cult Pamphlet: “The flesh is immortal,” hints about 
occult rituals being conducted in the food court 
 339 

Upper Level
 
Zombie Mall
basement. | 
| 2 | BioDyne Corporation Shipping Manifest: Lists 
“special meats” delivered to the labs beneath the mall, 
indicating secret experiments. | 
| 3 | Bloody Note: “We fed them the meats—now the 
Elder Ones rise!” scrawled hastily on butcher paper. | 
| 4 | Cryptic Pamphlet: Religious propaganda detailing 
the Rapture and marking this deli as a “sacred feast 
site.” | 
Hazards & Puzzles:
- The Meat Locker Puzzle:
Characters might find the freezer locked with a numeric 
keypad (DC 14 INT/Electronics check or DC 16 
DEX/Lockpick to open). Incorrect attempts activate an 
alarm (raises mall Tension by +5).

Electrical Panel:
A damaged circuit breaker near the freezer 
controls. Repairing it (DC 14 INT/Mechanical 
Repair) restores temporary power, allowing 
access to supplies but risks electric shock (DC 
13 DEX save or take 1d6 lightning damage).

- Special: Sonic scream alerts nearby zombies

- HD: 1 (5 HP per rat)
- #At: 1 (bite)
- Dam: 1d2 + possible infection (DC 12 CON save)
- Mv: 30ft, can fit through small spaces easily.

sites.name: 20/20 Vision
sites.bookText:
20/20 Vision
A  sleek  eyewear  store,  now  littered  with  broken 
lenses and abandoned optometry tools.
The elegant glass storefront of 20/20 Vision has 
shattered inward, leaving scattered shards across the 
black-and-white tiled floor. Designer frames, once 
neatly displayed, now lie bent and twisted atop 
overturned shelves and dusty countertops. Optometry 
chairs sit vacant, and diagnostic machines flicker 
occasionally with erratic sparks—ghostly reminders of 
lost normalcy. Shattered mirrors line the walls, reflecting 
distorted images of lurking horrors. A heavy curtain, 
partially torn down, conceals a darkened examination 
room in the back, from which faint noises occasionally 
emerge.
Description & Atmosphere 
(GM Notes):

Visibility:
Dimly lit by a flickering fluorescent panel 
overhead; low visibility and shifting shadows.

Sounds & Smells:
The floor crunches underfoot from glass and 
debris. There’s an antiseptic scent of sterilizing 
alcohol and an underlying odor of decay 
emanating from the examination room.

sites.name: Circuit Central
sites.bookText:
Circuit Central
“The  flickering  glow  of  shattered  display  screens 
paints eerie shadows on the cluttered walls of Circuit 
Central. Torn banners promoting the latest phones 
and gaming consoles dangle limply from the ceiling. 
Wires snake across the floor, tangled and knotted, 
while  static  occasionally  bursts  from  damaged 
speakers—whispers of static echoing throughout the 
shop.  A  faint,  repetitive  electronic  chirping  from  a 
malfunctioning  alarm  punctuates  the  silence, 
occasionally  broken  by  a  distant,  low  moan  from 
deeper inside.”
Description:
Circuit Central was once the heart of consumer tech in 
the mall, now reduced to a hazardous maze of toppled 
shelves, broken screens, and sparking wires. Zombies 
wander aimlessly through the aisles, attracted by 
intermittent static bursts from failing electronics. The 
store’s stockrooms and display cases might yet hold 
valuable technological loot—if survivors dare to 
navigate the electrical dangers and the undead roaming 
inside.

Lighting Condition:
| 1d6 | Lighting Condition | 

| 1-2 | Dark; power completely dead | 

| 3-4 | Dim flickering emergency lights | 

| 5-6 | Occasional blinding sparks from 
damaged wiring |

sites.name: SuperSave Mart
sites.bookText:
SuperSave Mart
Once  a  thriving  supermarket  that  drew  massive 
crowds with promises of bargain prices and weekly 
deals, SuperSave Mart now stands desolate, a dim 
shadow  of  its  former  bustling  self.  Flickering 
fluorescent  lights  cast  eerie  shadows  over  aisles 
littered with overturned shopping carts, spilled canned 
goods, and the rotting remains of produce scattered 
across a cracked tile floor. Pools of stagnant water 
leak  from  long-defrosted  freezer  units,  creating 
slippery puddles. Rotting meat and spoiled dairy give 
the air a rancid stench, attracting swarms of insects 
and  hungry  vermin.  Occasionally,  the  store’s  PA 
system  crackles  to  life,  echoing  distorted 
advertisements  and  cheerful  jingles  that  now  feel 
disturbingly out of place.
Hazards:

Spoiled Stock (Disease Risk):
o
Contact with spoiled food triggers a 
Constitution Save (DC 13) or 
contract Food Poisoning, imposing 
disadvantage on checks and attacks 
for 24 hours.

Collapsed Shelves (Structural):
o
Heavy shelving units precariously 
lean, toppling if disturbed (DEX Save 
DC 13 or suffer 2d6 bludgeoning 
damage and attract zombies).

Waterlogged Floors (Slip Hazard):
o
Moving quickly requires a DEX save 
(DC 12) or characters fall prone, 
drawing attention from nearby 
zombies.

Malfunctioning PA System:
1.
Occasionally activates loudly (20% 
chance every 10 minutes), 
immediately increasing Tension by 
+1d6 and attracting 1d6 zombies from 
outside.

sites.name: Strings & Things
sites.bookText:
Strings & Things
“The once-welcoming storefront of ‘Strings & Things’ 
 345 

Upper Level
 
Zombie Mall
is  now  hauntingly  quiet,  its  large  glass  windows 
fractured but surprisingly intact. Dust-covered guitars 
hang  silently  along  the  walls,  their  polished  wood 
catching flickers of fading daylight, and drum kits sit 
overturned, drumsticks scattered around in splinters 
like  the  remains  of  a  long-past  struggle.  A  single 
fluorescent bulb flickers intermittently, casting shifting 
shadows on sheet music scattered chaotically across 
the  tiled  floor.  Behind  the  counter,  an  ominously 
blood-streaked door leads to the back storage room.”
Room Description: Strings & Things is a music 
instrument store located on the upper level of the mall. 
Though relatively untouched compared to other stores, 
evidence of a struggle—scattered sheet music, 
splintered drumsticks, overturned stands—suggests 
something violent happened here. Players entering 
might trigger traps, accidentally alert hidden threats, or 
uncover secrets hidden amongst musical instruments 
and equipment.
Environmental Hazards (1d4):
d4
Hazard
1
Shattered Glass – Stepping 
carelessly deals 1d4 damage and 
attracts nearby zombies.
2
Collapsing Shelf: Dexterity check 
(DC 12) to avoid 1d6 damage and 
noise.
3
Tangled Wires: Difficult terrain, 
halves movement speed.
4
Suspended Speaker Trap: 
Triggered by failed Perception 
check (DC 15), falls dealing 2d6 
damage and loud noise.
Interactables/Loot:
Roll 1d8 twice for loot:
| d8 | Loot Found 
| 1 | Electric Guitar (Melee weapon, 1d6 bludgeoning + 
chance to stun zombies for 1 round on crit) | 
| 2 | Box of Guitar Strings (can be used for crafting 
traps, snares, or tripwires) | 
| 3 | Drumsticks (1d4 damage, easily breakable but 
plentiful; 2d8 available) | 
| 4 | Battery-powered Metronome (Distracts zombies 
if thrown, noise distraction) | 
| 5 | Sheet Music (“Songs of the Stars”) (hints at 
occult music rituals, see ambiguous lore) | 
| 6 | Electric Keyboard (Portable) (requires battery, 
attracts zombies, grants morale bonus when used) |

sites.name: Dough & Co.
sites.bookText:
Dough & Co.
The sweet smell of rot and sugar mixes nauseatingly 
in the stale air of Dough & Co. Pastry displays, once 
proudly showing glazed donuts and flaky croissants, 
now  hold  mold-covered  lumps  and  clouds  of  flies 
buzzing  lazily  through  shattered  glass.  Tables  sit 
overturned,  chairs  scattered  like  barricades  hastily 
abandoned.  Behind  the  counter,  the  espresso 
machine  sparks  intermittently,  spilling  thick  brown 
liquid  across  the  floor.  A  faint,  gurgling  hum  of  a 
malfunctioning refrigeration unit drones ominously in 
the  background.  The  cash  register  hangs  open, 
empty except for a scattering of pennies and a blood-
stained receipt.
Environmental Hazards:
- Slippery Floor: Leaking syrup and spoiled milk create 
slippery surfaces.
(DEX Save DC 12 or fall prone.) - Broken Espresso 
Machine: Occasionally sparks, risking mild 
electrocution.
(Touching machine: CON save DC 13 or take 1d4 
electrical damage.) - Flour Dust Cloud: Shelves are 
precariously balanced; disturbing them creates a cloud 
of flour.
(Con Save DC 13 or coughing loudly, increasing 
Tension by +2.)

on entry):
d6
Encounter Description

are clustered around an employee 
corpse in back.

counter, waiting to shriek at intruders.
3

hide in pastry cabinets.
4

named “Mia”) hiding behind the 
counter, armed with a knife.
5

dormant on the floor, looking like a 
bloated, decaying corpse.

stranger and cosmic in origin.

sites.name: Frosty Delights
sites.bookText:
Frosty Delights
Once a beloved gathering spot, Frosty Delights is 
now  an  eerie,  mold-riddled  monument  to  happier 
times.  Bright  pastel  walls  and  smiling  cartoon 
mascots contrast disturbingly with the layers of grime, 
mold, and dried puddles of ice cream. Chairs and 
tables lie toppled, with congealed pools of melted ice 
cream and scattered toppings covering the floors and 
countertops. A soft buzzing drone echoes from a still-
running freezer unit, blending with the ominous hum 
of malfunctioning fluorescent lights. Occasionally, a 
haunting  jingle  from  the  broken-down  ice  cream 
machine briefly fills the silence, drawing unwanted 
attention.
Encounter Randomization 
Table (d6)
d6

sites.name: Torque & Tune
sites.bookText:
Torque & Tune
“Scattered auto parts litter the polished tiles of this 
automotive accessory store. Racks of tires loom like 
silent sentinels, casting unsettling shadows beneath 
flickering fluorescents. A faint smell of rubber and 
motor oil hangs in the air, mixing unpleasantly with 
the  sickly-sweet  stench  of  decay  drifting  in  from 
deeper  within.  The  far  corner  is  obscured  by 
overturned  shelves,  tools  lying  discarded  as  if 
someone hurriedly tried—and failed—to fix something 
important.”
Room Details
Environment:
Torque & Tune was once popular with car enthusiasts 
seeking aftermarket upgrades, maintenance gear, and 
racing accessories. Now, abandoned in panic, it’s a 
jumbled mess of car parts, overturned shelves, and 
spilled fluids, making stealth difficult. Tools and car 
accessories are abundant, but navigation is tricky due 
to scattered debris.
 350 

Zombie Mall
 
Upper Level

Lighting: Dim and flickering; risk of darkness.

Sound: Metal clangs at random intervals due 
to falling debris or distant movement.

Visibility: Limited line-of-sight due to stacked 
tires and shelves.
Environmental Hazards Table (Roll 1d6 upon entry): 
| d6 | Hazard |
| 1 | Oil Spill: Dex save (DC 13) or fall prone, creating 
noise | 
| 2 | Fallen Shelf: Blocks main path, Strength check 
(DC 15) to move | 
| 3 | Car Battery Leak: Acidic fluid deals 1d4 acid 
damage if stepped on | 
| 4 | Precarious Tire Stack: May fall if disturbed, 
attracting 1d4 zombies | 
| 5 | Leaking Gas Canister: Could explode if gunfire 
occurs nearby (2d8 fire damage in 10-ft radius, Dex DC 
13 half damage) | 
| 6 | No Hazard: Safe navigation this time |
Interactables & Loot
Torque & Tune holds valuable survival items for 
resourceful survivors:
d6
Item Found
1
Tire Iron (Melee Weapon, 1d8 
damage, can pry doors/windows)
2
Jumper Cables (useful for 
electronics, vehicles, or improvised 
shock traps)
3

barricades or traps, AC +3 to 
entryways)
4
Toolbox (Improvised crafting & 
repairs, grants +2 to Mechanical 
Repair checks)
5
Can of Fuel (2 gallons, essential for 
generators or vehicles)
5
Car Battery (Craft battery-powered 
items or makeshift explosive traps)
6
Emergency Roadside Flares (1d6 
Fire damage, or used for signaling 
allies)
Interactables/Loot:
- Racing Tires (Set of 4): Perfect for quickly reinforcing 
or barricading doors/windows. (+10 SV each) - 
Mechanic’s Toolkit: Enables complex vehicle repairs 
or crafting improvised weapons (+25 SV) - 
Emergency Roadside Kit: Includes flashlight, flare, 
and first aid (+15 SV) - 
Vehicle Manual: Grants a bonus to Intelligence checks 
when repairing vehicles (+5 SV, +Lore clue) - 
Portable Air Compressor: Allows tire inflation, 
pneumatic weapon crafting, or noise distraction (+15 
SV) - 
Suspiciously Modified Car Battery: Possibly rigged to 
explode or electrify attackers (+15 SV, dangerous!)
Ambiguous Lore: - A torn memo pinned to the counter 
references “BioDyne deliveries” to the mall’s loading 
docks. Were these automotive shipments or covert 
biological transports? - Faded graffiti on the wall behind 
shelves reads cryptically: “They lied – it’s airborne. 
Cover your face.” - A repair receipt mentions “urgent 
repairs” to a vehicle with license plates matching a car 
in the parking garage—now mutated into a zombie-
machine hybrid.

sites.name: Vitality Foods
sites.bookText:
Vitality Foods
“The store’s sign—Vitality Foods—hangs loosely over 
the entrance, letters flickering weakly from residual 
power. Inside, neatly stocked shelves boast rows of 
colorful  containers:  protein  powders,  vitamins, 
supplements, and health bars—all strangely pristine, 
as if waiting for customers who never returned. A faint 
herbal scent masks the decay outside, though the 
eerie  stillness  suggests  something  unnatural  lurks 
within.”
Description:

Lighting: Dimly lit by flickering fluorescent 
lights overhead, occasionally sparking 
erratically.

Environment: The shop smells medicinal, with 
hints of herbs, powders, and the faint odor of 
spoiled wheatgrass. Shelves remain 
surprisingly orderly compared to other stores in 
the mall, suggesting minimal looting occurred 
here. The register is open and empty, a 
strange contrast to the neatly arranged 
products.

sites.name: Pulse Activewear
sites.bookText:
Pulse Activewear
“Behind  shattered  windows  and  under  flickering 
fluorescent lights, Pulse Activewear stands in eerie 
silence, racks of athletic clothing still neatly arranged 
as  if  the  apocalypse  had  politely  knocked  and 
stepped  aside.  Posters  featuring  smiling  fitness 
enthusiasts contrast grimly with bloody smears on the 
floor and walls. A faint metallic clang echoes from the 
fitting rooms in the back, followed by low, guttural 
breathing.  A  mannequin,  dressed  head-to-toe  in 
luminous neon running gear, stares blankly toward 
the  entrance—though  you’re  certain  its  head  was 
turned differently when you first entered…”
Description:
Pulse Activewear was once a popular store among 
fitness enthusiasts, boasting racks filled with athletic 
apparel, yoga mats, running shoes, and trendy 
moisture-wicking outfits. Now, its pristine displays and 
untouched shelves create a bizarre contrast with the 
devastation outside. Bright posters promising “Your 
Best You!” and “Run Faster, Live Longer!” mockingly 
adorn the walls, partially obscured by dark, dried blood 
splatters.

Hazard Level: Moderate

Lighting: Flickering fluorescents (occasional 
darkness, visibility reduced)

Zombie Threat: Moderate (hidden runners 
lurking between racks and changing rooms)
Environmental Hazards: - Slippery Floors: Blood 
stains or spilled energy drinks causing risk of slipping 
(DEX check or fall prone during combat) - Hanging 
Mannequins: Suspended mannequins that can swing 
down suddenly, startling survivors (WIS save or 
scream/raise Tension +1d4) - Security Gate: A half-
lowered security gate could trap or separate characters 
if disturbed carelessly (STR check to reopen)

sites.name: Tech & Trends
sites.bookText:
Tech & Trends
Flickering LED lights dance across shelves lined with 
shattered  screens  and  overturned  display  tables. 
Glass  crunches  beneath  your  feet  as  you  step 
carefully  through  a  landscape  of  obsolete  luxury 
gadgets  and  dangling  wires.  Amid  the  chaos, 
promotional holograms glitch and repeat their sales 
pitches  in  distorted  loops,  their  distorted  voices 
adding an eerie chorus to the oppressive silence. The 
faint  hum  of  a  malfunctioning  drone  intermittently 
breaks the silence, drifting erratically above.
Room Overview:
Tech & Trends was once the pinnacle of technological 
retail, proudly showcasing cutting-edge gadgets that 
became irrelevant overnight as civilization fell apart. 
The store layout is open yet cluttered, filled with 
scattered electronics and partially collapsed shelves 
providing ample cover—but also plenty of hidden 
dangers.
Environmental Conditions (1d4): | d4 | Condition | 
| 1 | Sparks and Electrical Fires – Exposed wires 
spark randomly, creating fire hazards and occasional 
electric shocks (1d6 damage). | 
| 2 | Leaking Batteries: Chemical spills create pools of 
corrosive fluids (DEX save or 1d4 acid damage). | 
| 3 | Flickering Screens: Screens occasionally burst to 
life with distorted imagery, distracting survivors (-1 on 
perception checks). | |
 4 | Tech Alarm: Motion-sensitive alarms may randomly 
activate, alerting zombies nearby (roll stealth to avoid 
detection). |
Zombies & Enemies (1d6): | d6 | Encounter |
| 1 | 1d4 Cyber-Zombies (reanimated customers with 
cybernetic implants) | 
| 2 | 2d4 Shamblers aimlessly wandering between 
displays | 
| 3 | Tech Cultists scavenging for rare electronic parts 
(hostile or negotiable) | 
| 4 | A single Brute Zombie tangled in wires, aggressive 
if disturbed | 
| 5 | 1d4 Stalker Zombies hidden among mannequins 
wearing smart watches | 
| 6 | Malfunctioning Security Drone (ranged taser 
attack, non-discriminatory) |

sites.name: Fix-a-Shoe
sites.bookText:
Fix-a-Shoe
Fix-a-Shoe is a cramped, cluttered shoe repair shop 
tucked into an overlooked corner of the mall’s upper 
level. The air is thick with the scent of leather and old 
glue,  mixing  unpleasantly  with  the  unmistakable 
stench of rot. Rows of shoes—some repaired, others 
in various states of disassembly—sit abandoned on 
dusty shelves. The cobbler’s workbench, littered with 
hammers, knives, heavy stitching awls, and jars of 
adhesives, stands exactly as the shopkeeper left it. 
Behind the counter hangs a yellowed poster, “We 
mend soles…but can we mend souls?”
The cramped space makes navigating difficult, 
increasing the danger if zombies breach the entrance.
Encounters & Random Events 
(1d6):
Roll when entering the store to determine initial 
conditions:
Roll 
(1d6)
Encounter/Event
1
A lone zombie cobbler still 
“working,” endlessly hammering 
shoes, oblivious unless disturbed.
2
Several shoes rigged with 
sharpened nails act as caltrops 
scattered across the floor (DEX 
save or 1d4 damage).
3
Hidden zombie lurks behind a stack 
of shoeboxes, surprising the first 
player to investigate.
4
A stray cat has made a home here, 
hissing but otherwise harmless 
unless startled loudly (attracting 
zombies).
5
The workbench lamp flickers 
erratically, occasionally plunging the 
room into darkness at the worst 
moment.
6
Radio behind the counter 
crackles faintly with static—if 
repaired, players hear 
fragmented military 
transmissions hinting at potential 
rescue or warnings of imminent 
danger.
Interactables/Loot:
Roll 1d4 times to determine available useful items:
d8 Roll Loot Found
1
Leatherworking Tools (can be 
used to reinforce armor, granting 
+1 AC once per character)
2
Heavy-Duty Bootlaces (can be 
improvised as rope or restraints, 
15 ft.)
3
Steel-Toed Boots (AC +1, +2 
damage to melee kicks, but -5ft 
speed)
4
Industrial Glue (enough for 1-2 
traps or improvised weapon 
crafting)
5
Cobbler’s Hammer (Melee, 1d6 
damage, robust enough for 
barricading)
6
Jar of Nails (can be scattered as 
caltrops or used in crafting 
barricades)
7
Hidden Cashbox ($50 cash, can 
be traded with other survivors)
8
Work Boots (Grants +1 to 
Constitution saves 
vs. environmental hazards or 
infections when worn)
 358 

Zombie Mall
 
Upper Level
Ambiguous Lore (Roll 1d4):
Hidden clues scattered around:
d4 Roll
Clue
1
A torn page from a religious 
pamphlet referencing the breaking 
of “The Sixth Seal” and judgment 
day.
2
Receipt from BioDyne Corp., 
detailing a large order of shoes 
marked “Experimental Materials – 
Hazard Class B.”
3
Strange symbols carved under the 
workbench, matching occult 
glyphs found elsewhere in the 
mall.
3
Hastily scribbled note: “The rats…
they whisper in the basement. 
Don’t trust them.”
4
Handwritten diary fragment 
describing strange lights and 
sounds from the mall’s rooftop 
shortly before the apocalypse.



defensible)


(Total potential ~50-100 SV)

cobbler.


valuable information (reducing Tension by -5 
due to increased preparedness).

- Dam: Claws 1d4 each, Bite 1d6 + Infection
- Mv: 30 ft
- Special: Gains a free surprise round unless spotted

sites.name: Opulence
sites.bookText:
Opulence (Upper Level - 
Shop #17)
The  elegant  sign,  though  tarnished  and  partially 
covered in grime, still reads  “Opulence” in flowing 
gold script. Stepping inside, your boots sink slightly 
into plush, mold-stained carpet as a faint aroma of 
mildew mingles with a lingering trace of fine perfume. 
Crystal  chandeliers,  long  darkened,  hang  over 
abandoned tables set for meals that never arrived. 
Dusty wine glasses, fine china plates, and polished 
silverware remain in eerie perfection, as if patrons 
had simply vanished mid-meal. Rows of untouched 
wine bottles gleam temptingly behind the ornate bar, 
and the smell of aged wine and decay hangs heavily 
in the air.
Description:
Once a high-end dining experience catering to the 
wealthiest of shoppers, Opulence now stands frozen in 
a decadent tableau of sudden abandonment. Tables 
are set with delicate china, silver utensils, and crystal 
glasses, many knocked askew by fleeing guests. The 
large central dining area is dimly lit, illuminated 
occasionally by flickering emergency lights casting eerie 
shadows across the velvet drapes and gilded mirrors.
At the back, a private dining room door hangs slightly 
ajar, hinting at secrets within. Behind the bar, hundreds 
of valuable vintage bottles rest temptingly, untouched 
amidst the apocalypse.
But the luxury conceals horrors. Something moves 
quietly among overturned chairs and beneath cloth-
covered tables, listening carefully for prey.
Hazards & Encounters:
 359

and gowns, stealthily stalk survivors from

flooring near the private dining room may 
collapse into a flooded utility corridor below.

under a table, ready to explode upon being disturbed. |

kitchen. | 
| 3 | Wine Shelf Collapse: Disturbing shelves causes 
bottles to crash loudly, attracting zombies (increase

| 4 | Luxury Mimic: One of the plush chairs is a bio-
experiment mimic that attacks when sat upon or closely 
examined. | 
| 5 | Corpse Banquet: A gruesome dining table where 
infected rats swarm over half-eaten remains (chance of 
disease exposure). | 
| 6 | Fine-Dining Cultist: An insane survivor dressed in 
tuxedo worshipping an eldritch idol, attempting to 
“invite” survivors to join a feast ritual. |

sites.name: Glow Up
sites.bookText:
Glow Up Cosmetics 
Boutique
 As  you  enter  Glow  Up,  the  scent  of  expensive 
perfume  hangs  thick  in  the  air,  mingling  with 
something less pleasant—mildew and decay. Dust-
covered  mirrors  line  the  walls,  reflecting  distorted 
images of mannequins posed in unnatural positions. 
Shelves  display  luxurious  cosmetics,  their  once-
vibrant colors muted beneath grime. At the center of 
the  boutique  stands  a  promotional  display,  eerily 
pristine,  illuminated  by  a  single  flickering  spotlight 
overhead. You hear faint dripping, echoing softly from 
somewhere within, and you can’t shake the feeling 
you’re being watched…
Hazards & Environment: - 
Slippery Floors: A bottle of oily moisturizer has 
shattered, creating slick, hazardous areas. Characters 
passing through must succeed a DEX Saving Throw 
(DC 12) or fall prone, causing noise. - 
Perfume Clouds: Broken bottles periodically release 
bursts of chokingly strong perfume. Characters entering 
clouds must succeed a CON Saving Throw (DC 13) or 
become incapacitated by coughing for 1 turn. - 
Mirrors of Madness: The large mirrors distort 
reflections subtly, unnerving survivors. Characters who 
linger near mirrors must pass a WIS Saving Throw (DC 
13) or suffer -1 to Perception checks for 1 hour due to 
paranoia.
Random Mirror Encounters (1d6)
1: A fleeting shadow moves behind you, but 
nothing’s there.
2: Your reflection smiles, though you didn’t.
3: Cracked glass distorts your face 
grotesquely (WIS save or minor sanity loss).
4: Strange symbols briefly appear behind 
your reflection.
3: You notice something written in lipstick 
on a mirror: “JOIN US”.
4: A zombified face stares back briefly, then 
fades away.
5: Your reflection looks desperate, mouthing 
silent warnings.
 361 

Upper Level
 
Zombie Mall
6: A mirror spontaneously cracks, 
triggering a noise event (+5 Tension).
Interactables/Loot:
Cosmetics (Potentially Useful): - 
Luxury Perfume Bottles (2d4): Worth 5 SV each 
(good for trading), flammable (improvised Molotov 
cocktails). - 
Makeup Kit: Improves Charisma-related interactions 
(+1 to CHA skill checks for 24 hours; 5 uses). - 
Compact Mirror: Useful for discreetly checking around 
corners, granting +1 on stealth perception checks.
Unique Items (1d6 Roll): 
| 1 | Luxury Perfume (“Intoxicating Temptress”): 
Valuable for trade (+25 SV), also flammable. | 
| 2 | Anti-aging Serum: Minor medical value (+5 
temporary HP), worth 20 SV. | 
| 3 | Manicure Kit: Precision tools grant +1 to 
Lockpicking attempts. | 
| 4 | Scented Candle (“Lavender Dreams”): Boost 
morale (+5 SV), reduce sanity loss temporarily. | 
| 5 | Makeup Kit (“Corpse Concealer”): Grants 
advantage on disguise checks among zombies for 1 
hour (one-time use). | 
| 6 | Lipstick with Hidden USB drive: Contains cryptic 
BioDyne research notes (see Ambiguous Lore). |
Ambiguous Lore: - Hidden among cosmetic samples 
is a crumpled pamphlet promoting a strange beauty 
treatment from the BioDyne Corporation, referencing 
“Project Eternal Youth.” It cryptically mentions “cellular 
rejuvenation,” “unexpected side effects,” and references 
an incident in “Sector 14C.”
Behind a shattered mirror panel, players might find 
hastily scribbled cult symbols alongside the phrase: 
“The veil thins; the Sixth Seal shatters. Ascension 
comes with sacrifice.”
Random Encounters (1d6):
| 1-2 | Beauty Zombies: Former employees now 
obsessed with applying cosmetics, smearing gore onto 
their faces (2-4 shamblers). | 
| 3 | Stalker Zombie: Hidden within the changing 
rooms, waiting to ambush isolated characters. | 
| 4 | Mannequin Mimic: Appears as a regular store 
mannequin, attacks anyone who touches it. | 
| 5 | Karen Screamer: Wanders aimlessly, shrieks 
loudly upon seeing survivors, attracting more undead. | 
| 6 | Cult Survivor (“Clara the Enlightened”): Non-
hostile at first; attempts to recruit or deceive survivors 
into her cause (can become ally or enemy). |
XP & Survival Value (SV): - Clearing and fully looting 
Glow Up grants 150 SV. - Finding the hidden USB 
drive adds an additional 250 SV (critical lore). - Each 
intact luxury cosmetic item (perfume/makeup) safely 
secured back at base grants 5 SV each.
Ambiguous Lore Summary: Glow Up hints at multiple 
possible origins of the apocalypse—whether it’s dark 
rituals hinted by symbols behind mirrors, BioDyne’s 
cosmetic experiments gone awry, or something cosmic 
causing cracks between realities. Players should feel 
drawn deeper into conspiracy theories without definitive 
answers.
XP & Survival Value (SV): | Action or Discovery | 
XP/SV Reward |

| Finding hidden USB Drive or Cult Lore | +250 SV |
 | Each luxury cosmetic item secured | +5 SV each |
